quests.title: The Number System Explorer Expedition
quests.description: Embark on an epic journey through the vast universe of number systems and discover mathematical infinity!

story.introduction: Welcome to the Number Universe Observatory! Professor Infinity has discovered new realms of numbers beyond imagination. Join the expedition to explore rational, irrational, and real numbers!

steps.title: Rational Number Space Station
steps.narrative: Board the Rational Number Space Station! Here, numbers that can be expressed as fractions rule the cosmos.

problem.question: Which of these numbers is rational?
problem.explanation: Space navigation success! 22/7 is rational because it's already in p/q form where p and q are integers and q ≠ 0!

steps.title: Irrational Mystery Planet
steps.narrative: Land on the mysterious Irrational Planet where numbers cannot be expressed as simple fractions! These numbers have infinite, non-repeating decimals.

problem.question: Why is √2 an irrational number?
options: It cannot be expressed as p/q where p,q are integers
problem.correct_answer: It cannot be expressed as p/q where p,q are integers
problem.explanation: Irrational mystery solved! √2 = 1.414213... goes on forever without repeating, so it can't be written as a simple fraction!

steps.title: Real Number Line Highway
steps.narrative: Travel the infinite Real Number Line Highway that contains ALL numbers - rational and irrational together in perfect mathematical harmony!

problem.question: Between any two rational numbers, what can you always find?
problem.explanation: Real number highway mastery! Between any two numbers, you can find infinitely many rational AND irrational numbers. The number line is densely packed!

steps.title: Challenge the Infinity Guardian
steps.narrative: The ultimate mathematical challenge! The Infinity Guardian tests your complete understanding of the number system universe!

problem.question: Prove your mastery: Which set contains all the others?
problem.explanation: Infinity Guardian defeated! Real numbers contain all others: Natural ⊂ Whole ⊂ Integers ⊂ Rational ⊂ Real. You've mastered the number universe!

quests.title: The Polynomial Detective Agency
quests.description: Join the elite detective agency that solves the most complex polynomial mysteries!

story.introduction: The Polynomial Detective Agency handles the most challenging algebraic cases! Chief Detective Poly needs your expertise to solve polynomial crimes and restore mathematical order!

steps.title: Polynomial Identification Training
steps.narrative: Your detective training begins! Learn to identify different types of polynomials and their degrees in the evidence room.

problem.question: What is the degree of the polynomial 3x⁴ + 2x² - 5x + 1?
problem.explanation: Detective training complete! The degree is the highest power of the variable. Here, x⁴ is the highest power, so the degree is 4!

steps.title: Factorization Crime Scene Investigation
steps.narrative: A polynomial has been found broken at the crime scene! Use factorization techniques to piece together the evidence.

problem.question: Factor the polynomial: x² + 7x + 12
problem.explanation: Crime solved! Find two numbers that multiply to 12 and add to 7. Those are 3 and 4, so the factors are (x + 3)(x + 4)!

steps.title: Remainder Theorem Laboratory
steps.narrative: In the high-tech laboratory, use the Remainder Theorem to solve polynomial division mysteries without actually dividing!

problem.question: Using the Remainder Theorem, find the remainder when x³ - 2x² + x - 1 is divided by (x - 1):
problem.explanation: Theorem mastery! Substitute x = 1: (1)³ - 2(1)² + (1) - 1 = 1 - 2 + 1 - 1 = -1. The remainder is -1!

steps.title: Showdown with the Polynomial Mastermind
steps.narrative: The ultimate polynomial challenge! The Polynomial Mastermind has created the most complex case ever. Solve it to become the agency's top detective!

problem.question: The Mastermind's challenge: If p(x) = x³ - 6x² + 11x - 6, and you know (x - 1) is a factor, find all factors!
problem.explanation: Mastermind defeated! Using synthetic division or factoring: p(x) = (x - 1)(x - 2)(x - 3). You're now the agency's top detective!

quests.title: The Coordinate Geometry Architect
quests.description: Design amazing structures using coordinate geometry and become a master mathematical architect!

story.introduction: The Coordinate Geometry Guild needs master architects! Architect Cartesian will teach you to design perfect structures using coordinate planes and geometric precision!

steps.title: Cartesian Plane Foundation
steps.narrative: Architect Cartesian shows you the magical coordinate plane where every point has a unique address! Master this foundation for all geometric construction.

problem.question: What are the coordinates of a point that is 3 units right and 4 units up from the origin?
problem.explanation: Coordinate mastery! The first number (3) is the x-coordinate (horizontal), the second number (4) is the y-coordinate (vertical). Perfect navigation!

steps.title: Distance Formula Expedition
steps.narrative: Embark on an expedition to measure distances between any two points in the coordinate plane! This formula is an architect's best tool.

problem.question: Find the distance between points A(1, 2) and B(4, 6):
problem.explanation: Distance expedition success! Using distance formula: √[(4-1)² + (6-2)²] = √[9 + 16] = √25 = 5 units!

steps.title: Linear Equation Graphing Studio
steps.narrative: Transform algebraic equations into beautiful geometric lines! Every linear equation creates a unique line on the coordinate plane.

problem.question: What is the slope of the line passing through points (0, 1) and (2, 5)?
problem.explanation: Graphing mastery! Slope = (y₂ - y₁)/(x₂ - x₁) = (5 - 1)/(2 - 0) = 4/2 = 2. The line rises 2 units for every 1 unit right!

steps.title: Geometric Proof Master Challenge
steps.narrative: The ultimate architectural test! The Geometric Proof Master challenges you to prove geometric relationships using coordinate geometry!

problem.question: Prove that the triangle with vertices A(0,0), B(3,0), and C(0,4) is a right triangle:
problem.explanation: Geometric Proof Master defeated! Sides AB (horizontal) and AC (vertical) are perpendicular, forming a 90° angle. You've proven it's a right triangle!
